plays.title: Marthe und ihre Uhr
plays.description: An elderly woman spends Christmas Eve alone in her room, listening to the ticking of her grandfather clock.

plays.title: Immensee
plays.description: A frame narrative of youthful romance, a white water lily, and the silent resignation of a life looking back.

plays.title: The Rider on the White Horse
plays.description: A self-taught dike-reeve builds a dike against the sea and his neighbours, then drowns with his family in the flood.
